A DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE

Chess, through time.

01

Up is forward in time.The board is the starting position. Each half-move adds a little height. A vertical line means a piece waited; a diagonal means it moved.

02

Follow several pieces.Click pieces to add or remove their paths, or use Add a piece in the explorer. Highlight as many as you like. Paths appear in both views. Path colors offers one moonlit color for every path, or amber for White and blue for Black. Captured pieces rest just below their capture plane, sized to leave room for the next occupant. Their path still ends at the exact capture time.

03

Travel through the game.Scrub the timeline or use ← and →. Space plays or pauses. Choose Forward, Reverse, or Back & forth, and speeds up to 10×. Smooth piece motion keeps the pieces and their trails moving continuously. Expand the player for an immersive view. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, and right-drag to pan.
